How it works

Start in under a minute

  1. Scan your cardThe el be Mama card from your obstetrician’s welcome pack or your birth pack. Scan it with your phone camera.
  2. Create your accountSign up with your email address.
  3. Enter your codeThe code on your card unlocks two months of free access to the el be app.
  4. Your class is waitingFind the programme for your stage, on your phone or TV.

A note from Louise

Hello, and welcome

I created el be Mama to bring trusted support together in one place: the experts I would want beside me, and a class waiting for you every week.

The app is a real community. Ask anything, and a professional Pilates instructor will be there to answer. There is no pressure and no right way to do this. Some weeks you will do a little, some weeks more. If you miss a day, that is fine. It will be there when you are ready.

Whether this card reached you at the start of your pregnancy or after the birth, we are so glad you are here.

Louise x

Your free access

Start your two months

Create your account and enter the code from your el be Mama card. Your two months of free access to the app start when you sign up.

Please follow the advice of your midwife, doctor or physiotherapist. Check with them before you start, especially after birth, and stop if anything feels wrong.
